scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w shared && cd backend && npm run dev
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build -w shared && cd backend && npm run worker
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w backend && npm run test:extension
scripts.test:extension: node --test extension/tests/page-hook.test.mjs extension/tests/background-input.test.mjs extension/tests/popup.test.mjs frontend/tests/configure-nginx.test.mjs frontend/tests/store-links.test.mjs frontend/tests/dashboard-display.test.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run format:check
